@nova2cotton
3) There are two categories. OO
Low Stress Training (LST) = bend, tie, reposition.
No cutting. The plant adapts through phototropism
and gravitropism without having to heal a wound.
High Stress Training (HST) = topping, FIMming,
supercropping. You damage or remove tissue on
purpose to force a new structure.
This distinction matters most with autos. Photos
can recover and you can just veg longer. Autos are
ona timer. Recovery time comes out of the middle
of the run, not the end.
When in doubt with autos, LST first.
